3277-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
3277-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5170-6132-7452-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

4186-5445-8095.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
4186-5445-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
4186-5445-8095.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

710-772-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

222-527-728-1251.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-3330.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2511-3330.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4871-5184-5626.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
The total mana value of the creature on the battlefield and the creature card in your graveyard is at most 6.
4871-5184-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
4871-5184-5626.notes: If the combined mana value of the creatures is less than 6, this combo will net infinite energy counters.

4605-6132-6797-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1086-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1086-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2061-2103-6927.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Damage Control Crew.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

439-4766-5683-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, causing you to put it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Arashin Sovereign and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Arashin Sovereign from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

338-4186-5070.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4186-5070.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4484-4871-5643-5686-6556.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5643-5686-6556.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5643-5686-6556.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

851-1322-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4094-5742-5743.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
392-4094-5742-5743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Harnfel by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Harnfel ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3263-6115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {C}{C}.
When Ozox dies, it triggers, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jumblebones, adding {C}{C}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1526-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1526-2608-4499.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.

165-499-1840-2034-3560.manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus two additional mana of any color(s)
165-499-1840-2034-3560.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one experience counter.
165-499-1840-2034-3560.description:
Cast False Dawn by paying {1}{W}.
Activate Daxos by paying {1}{W}{W}, creating a */* Spirit enchantment creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a 2/2 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus and Spirit, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Farrelite Priest twice by paying {2}, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat from step 2.

1722-2034-3583-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-4506.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

262-4289-4524.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Ethersworn Adjudicator.
Ethersworn Adjudicator does not have summoning sickness.
262-4289-4524.description:
Activate Ethersworn Adjudicator by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate three Elemental tokens by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Activate Ethersworn Adjudicator's second ability by paying {2}{U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3094-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Mishra's trigger.
Resolve the first Mishra trigger, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get four energy counters.
Resolve the second Mishra trigger from step 1,  creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
Put either Mishra's Warform into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the second Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, both Mishra's Warforms and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get six energy counters.
Activate the remaining Mishra's Warform by paying eight energy counters and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1295-1779-2177.manaNeeded: {6}{R/G}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
1295-1779-2177.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human nontoken creature.
1295-1779-2177.description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling all nonland permanent cards from your library.
Cast Illuna either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R/G}{U}{U} and command tax, if applicable, putting it over or under a non-Human nontoken creature you control.
Illuna triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

2836-4899.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2836-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Resolve a Phyrexian Devourer ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the exiled card's mana value.
If Phyrexian Devourer has a power of at least seven, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repeat steps 3-4 until you sacrifice Phyrexian Devourer, thus causing all remaining Phyrexian Devourer abilities to fail to resolve due to having no legal targets.
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

735-2438-4191-5220.notablePrerequisites: You have cast another blue spell this turn.
735-2438-4191-5220.description:
Cast Dream Thief by paying {0}.
Dream Thief enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dream Thief.
Dream Thief dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Dream Thief on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Dream Thief trigger from step 2, causing you to draw Dream Thief from the top of your library.
Repeat.

1041-2864.description:
Cast Worms of the Earth.
Activate That Which Was Taken, putting a divinity counter on Worms of the Earth.
Player's can not play lands or have lands enter the battlefield, and paying the cost to remove Worms of the Earth does not destroy it due to That Which Was Taken.

2104-2334-2493.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat

421-618.description:
Activate the mutated Huntmaster Liger and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.
